### EQC001 — Naive loss-style decoupling bound

*Provides the sufficient qubit-loss comparison and exposes why accessible measurement outcomes can improve the threshold.*

$$
\mathbb{E}_U\|\rho_{A_2\tilde B}-\rho_{A_2}^{max}\otimes\rho_{\tilde B}\|_1\le 2^{-(1-2p-\gamma)N/2},\quad \gamma<1-2p
$$

status: `verified` · source: paper_equations: paper-source/manuscript_arxiv_03.tex:238-264; main Eqs. (1)-(2)

Numerical form:

```
Evaluate the base-two exponent over finite N,gamma,p grids; used as a threshold oracle rather than source data.
```


### EQC002 — Tight decoupling bound with accessible outcomes

*Quantifies QEC protection under projective measurements and predicts p_c tending to one in the deep-scrambling large-block limit.*

$$
\mathbb{E}_U\|\rho_{RE}-\rho_R\otimes\rho_E\|_1\lesssim 2^{-(1-\gamma-p)N/2},\quad \gamma<1-p
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQC001` · source: paper_equation: paper-source/manuscript_arxiv_03.tex:257-264; main Eq. (3); supplement_equations: paper-source/manuscript_supp.tex:571-706; Cauchy-Schwarz, Haar contractions, and final bound

Numerical form:

```
Finite-N decoupling exponent and threshold line gamma=1-p, independently evaluated before comparison to entropy trajectories.
```


### EQC003 — Unitary frame potential and Haar lower bound

*Tests when finite-depth random Clifford circuits approximate unitary designs.*

$$
F_\nu^{(k)}=|\nu|^{-2}\sum_{U,V\in\nu}|\mathrm{Tr}(U^\dagger V)|^{2k}\ge k!
$$

status: `verified` · source: supplement_equations: paper-source/manuscript_supp.tex:118-165; Eqs. (S1)-(S3)

Numerical form:

```
Monte Carlo mean of Q_U^k with Q_U=|Tr U|^2 for depth-(2d-1) composite circuits.
```

Code: `src/frame_potential.py`, `scripts/run_supp_fig_s2.py`


### EQC004 — Clifford trace from the fixed-Pauli kernel

*Makes the n=22 frame-potential calculation polynomial instead of constructing an exponential unitary matrix.*

$$
Q_U=2^{-n}\sum_{P\in\mathcal P^+}\mathrm{Tr}(U^\dagger PUP^\dagger)\in\{0,2^{\dim\ker(S-I)}\}
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQC003` · source: supplement_equations: paper-source/manuscript_supp.tex:167-220; Eqs. (S4)-(S10)

Numerical form:

```
GF(2) nullity plus conjugation-phase consistency, returning an exact integer Q_U for each circuit.
```

Code: `src/frame_potential.py`, `tests/test_frame_potential.py`
